title: BlackRock, GIC among investors chasing Indian telecom major Jio's IPO as anchor bids top $26 billion
summary_full: Jio Platforms plans to raise up to $3.2 billion through an IPO, which is India's largest ever in rupee terms, but the second largest in dollar terms.
